3 03-11-2025 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The accused/petitioner is named in the FIR and apprehending his arrest in connection with Khagaria (Muffasil) P.S. Case No.476 of 2023 registered under Sections 366-A read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code but, later on, Sections 376 of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of the Protection of the Children from Sexual Offences Act was added in the FIR.

entities.text: Protection of the Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Allegation against the petitioner is to kidnap the minor daughter of the informant aged about 14 years for the purpose of sexual intercourse/marriage.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57597 of 2025(3) dt.03-11-2025 4.

It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that while recording statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure (in short 'CrPC'), the victim categorically stated that this petitioner was not involved in her kidnapping.
It is further submitted that the entire allegation appears to be raised against co-accused Sunil.

6. Considering the aforesaid statement of victim under Section 164 of the CrPC, declining any involvement of this petitioner with present crime in question, accordingly, the petitioner,
above-named, in the event of his arrest or surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks from today, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Khagaria in connection with Khagaria (Muffasil) P.S. Case No.476 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the CrPC/under Section 482(2) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Patna High Court CR.
